parameters.name: IncidentUuid
parameters.description: The globally unique ID of the event.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the threat analysis feature is deployed. Select the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: For assets in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: For assets in regions outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The ID of a member account. An administrator can use this parameter to switch to the perspective of the member account.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The account scope to which the rule applies. Valid values:

- 0: The current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: All accounts within the enterprise.

parameters.name: WhiteruleList
parameters.description: The alert whitelisting rule, which is a JSON object.
